healthAdvisory.title: Health Advisory Hub
healthAdvisory.subtitle: How current air quality impacts your organs, and recommended steps to protect yourself.

lungs.title: Lungs
lungs.impact: Fine particles inflame airways, triggering asthma, bronchitis, and long-term capacity reduction.

heart.title: Heart
heart.impact: Microscopic pollutants pass into blood, causing inflammation, arterial stiffness, and clotting risk.

skin.title: Skin
skin.impact: Smog and soot block pores, leading to oxidative stress, moisture loss, and premature aging.

eyes.title: Eyes
eyes.impact: Gaseous pollutants like ozone and nitrogen dioxide cause burning sensations, redness, and dry eyes.

brain.title: Brain
brain.impact: Pollutant exposure is linked to cognitive fog, headaches, reduced concentration, and long-term neurological decline.

immune.title: Immune System
immune.impact: Chronic exposure weakens immune response, increasing susceptibility to respiratory infections and slower recovery times.

general.label: General Public
general.desc: Advisories and tips for healthy adults with no pre-existing conditions.

sensitive.label: Sensitive Groups
sensitive.desc: Essential guidance for individuals with asthma, heart conditions, or allergies.

vulnerable.label: Children & Elderly
vulnerable.desc: Protective actions tailored for developing lungs and older age groups.

mask.title: Wear a Mask
mask.detail: Use an N95/N99 mask during peak traffic hours or when AQI exceeds 150.

ventilation.title: Monitor Ventilation
ventilation.detail: Keep windows closed when local AQI is high; open them during clean wind hours.

exercise.title: Optimize Exercise
exercise.detail: Shift intense cardio sessions indoors if the AQI rises above 100.

inhaler.title: Rescue Inhaler
inhaler.detail: Keep prescribed quick-relief medication handy at all times when outdoors.

purifier.title: Run Air Purifiers
purifier.detail: Keep HEPA filters active in your bedroom and workspace to reduce indoor triggers.

limit.title: Limit Exposure
limit.detail: Avoid walking near main roads during peak congestion and early mornings.

walks.title: Avoid Morning Walks
walks.detail: Air pollutants settle close to the ground in the early morning; walk in the afternoon instead.

diet.title: Nutritious Diet
diet.detail: Consume foods rich in Vitamin C, E, and Omega-3 to help combat system-wide oxidative stress.

play.title: Indoor Play
play.detail: Keep kids active with creative indoor activities instead of playing outdoors when AQI exceeds 100.

ev_transition.title: ⚡ 30% EV Adoption
ev_transition.description: Replace 30% of fossil-fuel vehicles on city roads with zero-emission EVs.
ev_transition.details: Dramatically lowers tailpipe combustion NO₂ emissions and reduces brake dust PM2.5.

urban_canopy.title: 🌳 20% Green Canopy
urban_canopy.description: Expand city tree cover, rooftop gardens, and urban parks by 20%.
urban_canopy.details: Leaves and vegetation trap airborne fine particulate matter and absorb gaseous pollutants.

industrial_scrubbers.title: 🏭 Emission Controls
industrial_scrubbers.description: Mandate advanced particulate scrubbers across nearby factories and power plants.
industrial_scrubbers.details: Targeted stack filtration cuts bulk industrial PM2.5 and atmospheric nitrogen oxides.

renewable_grid.title: ☀️ 50% Clean Energy
renewable_grid.description: Transition half of the regional electricity grid to clean renewable energy sources.
renewable_grid.details: Phases out coal and gas thermal generation, drastically cleaning regional air sheds.

carbonCalculator.title: Personal Carbon Footprint Calculator
carbonCalculator.subtitle: Estimate your monthly CO₂ emissions from daily transport, electricity, cooking fuel, and travel. Understand your environmental impact and adopt simple habits to cut emissions.
